description: 648 canonical decoded data, texture-order and hierarchy records from 12 valid fixtures loaded by pre-migration production RSX loader; actual strings and list containers retained, pointer-list clear delegated to equivalent production list clear. Unreached UI vector stubs abort.
limitations: Valid fixtures only, with 3 frames, child before parent, shared/per-frame UV records, repeated texture indices, Korean names and original version-dependent header reading. Failure cases are new guarded tests.
